items.docs: This API fetches the subdomain of the support email address.

This API updates the subdomain (the "~mycompany~" part) of the support email address.!!1. Only the primary contact of the organization can update the subdomain of the support email address.!2. The new support email address will be support@zylker.com.!3. The updated support email address will be used for fetching emails, henceforth. So make sure that you update the new address in the forwarding configurations of your mailbox.!4. The new support email address is applicable only for the default dep
